tools.name: get_current_session
tools.title: Get current session
tools.description: Return the currently selected ST2 session — kind, opponent/label, date, duration, halves, venue, weather, and result.

tools.name: list_squad
tools.title: List squad
tools.description: List every athlete on the current session, including position, participation tag, minutes played, HR coverage, and sRPE submission status.

tools.name: get_attention_flags
tools.title: Get attention flags
tools.description: Return the current session's Tier-1 attention flags — athletes that need attention, their severity (escalate/notice), the reason, and the underlying read (value-on-track delta or gap between external and internal load).
